children: Azenta appointed Dr. Martin D. Madaus as Interim President and Chief Executive Officer, effective August 22, 2026, and approved his compensation and equity grants while also awarding retention restricted stock units to four named executives.
Interim President and Chief Executive Officer
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
Senior Vice President and President, Multiomics
August 22, 2026 (Start Date); Letter Agreement dated September 14, 2026; CEO Grant Date September 14, 2026
Appointment by Board; Letter Agreement approved by Board upon Committee recommendation

Eligible for health and welfare plans; at-will employment; annual base salary $600,000; cash performance bonus equal to 100% of base salary (vesting provisions); RSU award valued $1,200,000 vesting monthly over 12 months
Retention RSU award value: $1,000,000 (time-based; 50% vests at year 1 and 50% at year 2)
Retention RSU award value: $500,000 (time-based; 50% vests at year 1 and 50% at year 2)
Retention RSU award value: $500,000 (time-based; 50% vests at year 1 and 50% at year 2)
Retention RSU award value: $500,000 (time-based; 50% vests at year 1 and 50% at year 2)
Ceded membership of Nominating and Governance Committee; committee reconstituted with William L. Cornog (Chair), Frank E. Casal and Robyn C. Davis
